paragraphs.text: Wren's Run is a dense and intricate area of forest located within Lorwyn . Renowned as one of the most prestigious hunting grounds in Lorwyn , Wren's Run is carefully managed by elvish packmasters who introduce rare and exotic creatures from across the plane to stock the area. This forest maze serves as the traditional site for the coming-of-age hunts, a vital rite of passage for young members of the exquisite and perfect castes.
